create_capturepoint: create a CapturePoint object with a recording timestamp and list of Capture objects
configure_benchmark: configure a BenchmarkConfig with output_path, output_name, and run_time settings
setup_benchmark_node: setup a Benchmark labgraph node that spawns a BenchmarkWorker process for recording timestamps
subscribe_capture_results: subscribe to CaptureResult messages on the Benchmark node INPUT topic to record timestamps
publish_exit_signal: publish an ExitSignal on the OUTPUT_EXIT topic when benchmarking is complete and done
